svg.title: deja vu: a memory brought back by a scent
svg.desc: philia's korean and english lyric scrapbook for rescene's deja vu. a blue and orange handwritten collage of breeze, scent, dreams and recurring memories, with three original mv stills and hand-drawn lyric corner marks.

text.tspan: the memory of that day, brought back by a scent.
